pretraining: public CLIP ViT-B/16; fresh ReID heads; no earlier research checkpoints
checkpoint_rule: highest development mAP; ties keep earliest epoch; official test not used
evaluation_scope: identity-heldout development only, not full-training paper reproduction
amp_policy: native DeMo fp16 GradScaler; skipped updates counted separately from batch attempts
method_revision: P1 retrieval utility: unchanged source-specific interface B plus stopped-reference joint margin gain on its actual residual path
missing_protocol: exactly zero normalized inputs determine availability; structured relations require all their members available; no modality-dropout training in this stage
residual_anchor: Unchanged V5 M/I; shared PF per source-specific relation, stopped original per-relation norms, F amplitude scale .05 times Fgate and legal relation weight; zero tail5632D
relation_routing: unchanged V5 joint pi relation marginal times eligible relation count; independent a_S for M-only
unchanged_V5_factors: backbone, FFT, expert parameters, full cross-condition/router, auxiliary taps, gates, loss weights, contribution reference, optimizer, split, sampling, public CLIP and50; F interface uses perS pooling and independent F-only relation weights

retrieval_gain.reference: stopped base00 current training batch, same legal hard positive/negative for all states
retrieval_gain.gradient: direct base coordinate removed; expert/shared backbone input gradients remain

contribution_sanity.reference: one stopped-gradient current-batch full11 gallery; same indices for all four states, no EMA

retrieval_gain_sanity.reference: One stopped current-training-batch base00 gallery and the same hardest legal positive/negative for all states
